notice: These are dogfood observations from Tooling Atlas development. They are useful findings, but they are not matched baseline/candidate performance evidence.

observations.test: Inspect eleven independent design-source repositories in one bounded read batch.
observations.result: The repositories were reached in one orchestration round trip, but the combined result reached 50,391 source tokens and was truncated.
observations.finding: Batching without a strict per-source return shape moved the bottleneck from latency to context size.
observations.change: Limit every source to hero composition, frame, section order, responsive rule, and provenance; cap each result before synthesis.

observations.test: Recover the design audit after the oversized multi-repository result.
observations.result: Follow-up retrieval was narrowed to exact selectors and source ranges, while the working set retained all eleven project paths and the requested reconstruction fields.
observations.finding: Narrow retrieval preserved the evidence needed for implementation without rereading complete source files.
observations.change: Add an explicit output budget and compact resume packet to future broad Atlas audits.

observations.test: Inspect the current Crumb design profile and Context Budget module using DOM state plus visible screenshots.
observations.result: The design profile had only two narrative sections and no visual preview; the module page had five useful sections but no visible test bench or evidence ledger.
observations.finding: The content existed, but the presentation did not make reconstruction or evaluation easy.
observations.change: Add a visual reconstruction blueprint, anatomy/spec tables, responsive rules, test cases, and qualified findings.

observations.test: Run the scorer against synthetic baseline/candidate observations and inspect the resulting decision.
observations.result: The scorer preserved the synthetic label and returned collect-more with one of six required pairs rather than promoting the module.
observations.finding: The evidence gate resists accidental proof claims from incomplete or synthetic data.
observations.change: Run measured agent pairs next; keep field observations visually separate from benchmarks.
